name: web-design-guidelines
title_zh: UI 代码过一遍 Web 界面规范清单的审稿人
tagline_zh: 说一句「检查我的界面」，它逐条对照 26 条业界规范，揪出对比度不足、焦点丢失、点按目标过小。
tagline_en: Say "review my UI" and it audits against 26 web guidelines—contrast, focus, tap targets, even HTML semantics.
desc_en: Review UI code for Web Interface Guidelines compliance. Use when asked to "review my UI", "check accessibility", "audit design", "review UX", or "check my site against best practices".
why_zh: 不是泛泛而谈的设计建议，而是直接读你的代码，按可勾选的规范清单逐项判定，给的是能改的具体行号与修法。
why_en: It reads your actual code, not vibes—checks against a checklistable spec, and points to exact lines with fixes.
limit_zh: 只审前端代码（HTML/CSS/JS），不审 Figma 稿；只覆盖 Web 界面规范清单上的 26 条。
limit_en: Only front-end code (HTML/CSS/JS), not design files. Covers the 26 Web Interface Guidelines only—not a full a11y audit. Outputs findings + fixes, no.
title_en: UI code reviewer for Web Interface Guidelines
